profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record, mapped in June 2025 by a single contributor as Encompass MSP, corresponds to Encompass Digital Media transmission and fiber hub facility in Lino Lakes, Minnesota, roughly 13 miles north of Minneapolis-St Paul at 6221 Holly Drive. Despite the name similarity, Encompass Digital Media is an entirely different company from Compass Datacenters, the Dallas-based wholesale data center developer covered elsewhere in this dataset, and the two should not be confused. Encompass Digital Media describes itself, on its own website, as a global managed-services company supporting broadcasters, television networks, sports leagues, and streaming platforms, handling channel playout, satellite and fiber content distribution, and disaster-recovery uplink services for major broadcast clients. Its Lino Lakes site sits on roughly 100 acres and, per the operator own description, houses a teleport and specializes in disaster-recovery uplink solutions that provide primary backup for key broadcast clients, functioning as network and transmission infrastructure rather than a commercial colocation data center of the kind featured elsewhere on this site. The company traces to Ascent Media Corp Content Distribution business, which included network-origination facilities in the US, UK, and Singapore and was already described in Ascent own 2010 SEC filing as one of the largest independent broadcast facilities operators in the country before Encompass acquired it for roughly 113 million dollars in December 2010. Encompass has no SEC filings of its own as a private company, but appears in the loan portfolio of TCW Direct Lending VII, a business development company whose 2026 quarterly filing lists an outstanding term loan to Encompass Digital Media originally made in October 2018 and maturing in 2026, confirming the company is currently financed through private credit rather than public markets. Notably, the OpenStreetMap contributor who mapped this site explicitly noted in their changeset comment that data center was simply the best available building classification for what is actually a broadcast teleport facility, an honest acknowledgment that the telecom=data_center tag is an approximation rather than a precise description of the site function. No capacity, square footage, or year-built figure is asserted here because none is published for this specific facility, and the site should be understood as broadcast transmission infrastructure, not conventional IT colocation space.

reading.body:
This facility is a broadcast teleport and transmission hub, not a conventional AI data center. Encompass Digital Media operates it as disaster-recovery uplink infrastructure for television networks and streaming platforms, handling content distribution and satellite operations rather than providing colocation racks for compute workloads. The OpenStreetMap record that surfaces it here was tagged as a data center only because no better building classification existed, a limitation the mapper explicitly acknowledged.

No capacity figure is published for this site. The facility sits on roughly 100 acres in Lino Lakes, Minnesota, about 13 miles north of Minneapolis-St Paul, and serves as network and transmission infrastructure. Minnesota has 13 mapped facilities in this dataset, only 2 of which publish power capacity figures totaling 10 MW. This campus does not contribute to that published total.

The operator traces to Ascent Media Corp, one of the largest independent broadcast facilities operators in the United States before Encompass acquired it in 2010. Encompass is privately held, currently financed through a term loan from TCW Direct Lending VII maturing in 2026, and describes itself on its own website as a managed-services company for broadcasters and sports leagues. It is not positioned as a wholesale colocation provider for AI workloads and publishes no IT capacity specification for this location.
